overview_description.description: Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait is a commercial bank that offers personal, corporate, and private banking, catering to a diverse clientele. The bank has two full-service branches in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, marking it as the first Kuwaiti bank to establish a presence in the UAE. Additionally, ABK operates a wholesale banking branch in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) with a Category 1 license. Through its subsidiary, Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait – Egypt, ABK has expanded its footprint with other branches across the country, offering a wide array of banking services.
